properties.name: Fixed agrivoltaic pilot
properties.edge_logic: Exact issued boundary; forage and jojoba retained; no redesign or new capacity credited.

properties.name: Fixed living pilot
properties.edge_logic: Exact issued living outline; no redesign.

properties.name: Mountain stewardship
properties.edge_logic: Retained source-DEM steep/high terrain interpretation; not reclassified as energy to meet a target.

properties.name: Drainage and dry landscape links
properties.edge_logic: Retained seasonal-drainage/landscape account; not a lake or statutory exclusion; detailed suitability remains unresolved.

properties.name: Western arrival and trade reserve
properties.edge_logic: Western approach to retained SW public/regional spine; angular edge is an entrant service boundary, not cadastre. First gate is access-only; no customs or throughput entitlement.

properties.name: Eastern domestic transfer reserve
properties.edge_logic: Compact junction of regional east-west spine and south-east branch. Domestic consolidation only; does not claim a Chilean border port or approved highway connection.

properties.name: Southwest living and civic territory
properties.edge_logic: Compact town plus future public-service catchment at SW arrival. Northeast service limit is pulled back from prior basin; excludes separate works/farm parcels. Only the existing 5.76km2 town carries population capacity.

properties.name: Central processing and repair corridor
properties.edge_logic: A declared 3.2km-wide operating corridor along the first15.5km of the proposed central transfer route. Replaces 252km2 general industry. Width is a service-envelope choice, not a road ROW or buildable-area result; no new operating capacity credited.

properties.name: Western and central agricultural territory
properties.edge_logic: Western alluvial-fan study expanded into the central valley/service catchment released from general industry. Edges follow declared field-service envelopes; soils, lawful irrigation and flood design must qualify actual fields. Not all land is irrigated.

properties.name: Southern energy and compute works
properties.edge_logic: Separate existing proposed compute and solar parcels south of town; land released from the old living basin remains an energy/service study, not housing capacity.

properties.name: Northern solar-energy territory
properties.edge_logic: Retains northern shoulder allocation served by northern route study. No cultivation credit without a separate crop/water design.

properties.name: Central and eastern energy territory
properties.edge_logic: Released former oversized industrial/logistics regions now form the main conditional solar-energy/service territory, outside retained mountain/drainage units. Future field subdivisions follow access/drainage studies; polygon area is neither panel area nor power capacity.
properties.numerical_repair: Submillimetre inward nudge to remove touching-ring projection slivers; account rounded to0.01km2.
